def VTask.sumLexLift {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {γ₁ : Type u_5} {γ₂ : Type u_6} (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) : α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) :=
  fun a b =>
    match a, b with
    | ⟨a₁, inl b₁⟩ =>
      have h₁ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := by
        -- Case: First input is inl a₁, second is inl b₁
        -- Use f₁ a₁ b₁ to construct a finset of inl elements in γ₁ ⊕ γ₂
        have h₁ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := Finset.image (fun c => inl c) (f₁ a₁ b₁)
        exact h₁
      exact h₁
    | ⟨a₁, inr b₂⟩ =>
      have h₂ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := by
        -- Case: First input is inl a₁, second is inr b₂
        -- Combine g₁ a₁ b₂ and g₂ a₁ b₂ into a finset of inl and inr elements in γ₁ ⊕ γ₂
        have h₂ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := Finset.sum (g₁ a₁ b₂) (fun c => inl c) ∪ Finset.sum (g₂ a₁ b₂) (fun c => inr c)
        exact h₂
      exact h₂
    | ⟨a₂, inl b₁⟩ =>
      have h₃ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := by
        -- Case: First input is inr a₂, second is inl b₁
        -- Return the empty finset
        have h₃ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := ∅
        exact h₃
      exact h₃
    | ⟨a₂, inr b₂⟩ =>
      have h₄ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := by
        -- Case: First input is inr a₂, second is inr b₂
        -- Use f₂ a₂ b₂ to construct a finset of inr elements in γ₁ ⊕ γ₂
        have h₄ : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := Finset.image (fun c => inr c) (f₂ a₂ b₂)
        exact h₄
      exact h₄
